entries.reason: Direct DT boot without UEFI; the kernel continues with the FDT root.

entries.pattern: brcmvirt-gpio soc:firmware:virtgpio: Failed to set gpiovirtbuf, trying to get err:0
entries.reason: QEMU property mailbox does not implement the firmware GPIO buffer tags.

entries.pattern: brcmvirt-gpio soc:firmware:virtgpio: Failed to map physical address
entries.reason: The unsupported firmware buffer cannot be mapped; it is not the block device.

entries.pattern: brcmvirt-gpio soc:firmware:virtgpio: probe with driver brcmvirt-gpio failed with error -2
entries.reason: The preceding buffer-map failure returns ENOENT to the driver core.

entries.pattern: raspberrypi-exp-gpio soc:firmware:expgpio: Failed to get GPIO ([0-7]) config \(0 8\1\)
entries.reason: The unimplemented GPIO configuration tag leaves the requested GPIO value unchanged.

entries.pattern: bcm2835-aux-uart 3f215040\.serial: error -EINVAL: unable to register 8250 port
entries.reason: Registration returns EINVAL; the precise inner branch remains unverified, so this stays fatal.

entries.pattern: bcm2835-aux-uart 3f215040\.serial: probe with driver bcm2835-aux-uart failed with error -22
entries.reason: Driver-core report of the unresolved auxiliary UART registration failure; stays fatal.

entries.pattern: check access for rdinit=/init failed: -2, ignoring
entries.reason: No initramfs /init; prepare_namespace mounts SquashFS and runs /sbin/init.

entries.pattern: Re-reading the partition table failed\.: Device or resource busy
entries.reason: Only the next userspace line after the known partition 4/7 growth step, allowing kernel-line interleaving, with subsequent setup synchronization.

entries.pattern: platform leds: deferred probe pending: leds-gpio: Failed to get GPIO '/leds/led-act'
entries.reason: The activity LED depends on the unsupported virtual firmware GPIO; storage does not.

entries.pattern: mmc1: Failed to initialize a non-removable card
entries.reason: mmc1 is the unpopulated Wi-Fi SDIO host, not the mmc0 SD image.
